evals.prompt: Use $motioner to create a finished six-second vertical motion graphic for a fictional note app called Papertrail. Work in a new empty folder. Deliver 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 with audio, exactly 30 fps and 180 frames. Show a messy cluster of notes becoming one clear card, then reveal the app name. No voice. Keep it readable on a phone. Source suitable licensed SFX and a visual asset online where they improve the film. Make the note-to-card handoff a visible morph, not just a dissolve. Select a clean but distinctive font after comparing two title specimens. Deliver the actual render and a short note on how you checked its transitions, sound, and imagery.
evals.expected_output: A real 180-frame film with a traceable shape handoff, purposeful online SFX, considered typography, documented assets, whole-film audiovisual review, and verified stream properties.

evals.prompt: Use $motioner to make an eight-second product demo from the example app folder I provide. Keep that folder read-only and put all new files elsewhere. Show one real interaction from before state through pointer contact to a visibly different after state, then a short brand ending. Use Remotion if suitable. Deliver 1920x1080, 24 fps, exactly 192 frames, H.264 MP4 with audio, no voice. Verify every product label and identity asset from the app. Source and document suitable online SFX and visuals. Inspect the encoded film for off-target clicks, preexisting results, clipped or ghosted text, weak font choice, and sound timing.
evals.expected_output: A faithful separate-folder 192-frame demo whose click hits the target and causes a new state; authentic or clearly conceptual identity; purposeful visual and sound sourcing; full encoded picture and sound review.

evals.prompt: Use $motioner to create a 20-second 1920x1080 branded tutorial for a fictional learning app whose small demo source, official logo, and brand palette I provide. Show five distinct steps including one card click that opens a different detail view. The detail view must not appear before the click. Use seamless scene handoffs with at least two genuine shared-element or shape morphs. One chapter is cool blue and the next is warm coral; design a palette bridge that belongs to the supplied brand instead of an arbitrary color flash. Use expressive but clean type, meaningful microanimation, and rich purposeful SFX sourced online. Keep source files read-only. Deliver an H.264 MP4 with audio and evidence from the encoded export: interaction before/contact/after frames, start/midpoint/end frames and a good/weak verdict for each morph or seamless boundary, type specimens, asset manifest, and a full watch/listen review. Revise any weak boundary and recheck it. If playback is unavailable, label it a draft rather than final.
evals.expected_output: A multi-step branded film that passes the interaction, identity, transition, typography, sourcing, sound, and full-review gates in review-scorecard.md; each morph or seamless boundary has encoded start/midpoint/end frame evidence, palette continuity notes, an individual good/weak/unverified verdict, and a rerendered recheck for any weak handoff; no universal cue or asset quota.

evals.prompt: Design a static square poster for a fictional music festival. Export a PNG. Do not animate it or produce video.
evals.expected_output: Motioner should not trigger automatically for a static image request.
